issues.body: This diff exports SdCryptosuite, IngestedSdCredential, and ingest_sd_credential_unverified, but does not update skills/zk-query-proofs/SKILL.md. That skill currently describes bbs-2023 and ecdsa-sd-2023 as a deferred seam and explicitly lists selective disclosure as out of scope. Besides violating the repository's same-change maintenance rule for public APIs, the contradiction is security-relevant: users consulting the supported usage surface will not receive accurate instructions and caveats for this deliberately unverified ingest path.
issues.fix_hint: Update skills/zk-query-proofs/SKILL.md in this PR to document the three new public items, feature gate, exact unverified/provenance-only semantics, separation from verify_source_proof, empty-input behavior, and the sq-qhy4 external-audit caveat. Replace the existing statements that the two SD suites are deferred/out of scope. Also update the crate README if it is the crate-level public API guide, as required by the shared maintenance contract.
issues.title: New public SD ingest API is absent from the required skill documentation

verdict.summary: The implementation is unusually explicit and honest about the unverified selective-disclosure seam, keeps SD suites out of the verified-suite parser, and includes meaningful tests for type separation, provenance, empty input, and content binding. However, this adds a substantial public API while leaving the repository's required public-surface skill documentation stale: the existing zk-query-proofs skill still says bbs-2023/ecdsa-sd-2023 are deferred and out of scope. That makes the change incomplete and gives users contradictory guidance about a security-sensitive API.
